description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Event' controller class for the admin marketplace in OpenCart. It defines methods for listing, enabling, disabling, and deleting marketplace events, including handling HTTP requests, permissions, and rendering views.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace events in the admin panel of OpenCart. Provides functionalities for listing, enabling, disabling, and deleting events, along with permission checks and view rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of marketplace events with sorting, pagination, and navigation breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to display the list of events, setting up sorting and pagination parameters, and rendering the event list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Builds and returns the HTML view for the list of events, including table headers, data rows, and pagination.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables a specific event by its ID, setting its status to active via the model, and returning a JSON response.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables a specific event by its ID, setting its status to inactive via the model, and returning a JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected events based on posted IDs by invoking the model's delete method, with permission checks, and responds with JSON.
